statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The diagnosis codes are I48.91, I25.10, and R55
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations
The patient has known atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has frequent premature ventricular contractions that cause dizziness and fatigue
The service is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate control management
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
